title: HERO – Blender Grease Pencil Showcase
summary: HERO is a short animated film made entirely in Blender to showcase the Grease Pencil 2D animation tools in Blender 2.8. It mixes hand-drawn 2D with a full 3D pipeline.
why: HN points to it as an impressive demo of Blender's open-source 2D/3D hybrid animation and as a comparison for other 2D animation tools.

quote.text: the demo the foundation commissioned was amazing. I love how seamlessly they mix the 3D in with the direct illustration.
